description: A small, illustrative packaged-food allergen/nutrition labeling ruleset for a completely different regulation and product category than IN-LMPC-2011, used only to prove that backend/engine/ needs zero code changes to support a new regulation -- everything here is DATA. Not a real jurisdiction's actual regulation; do not use for real compliance decisions.

rules.name: Major allergens declared when present
rules.description: If any of the recognised major allergens is present among the ingredients, it must be called out separately in an allergen statement.
rules.message_pass: An allergen present in the ingredient list is called out in a separate allergen statement.
rules.message_fail: An allergen appears in the ingredient list but no allergen statement was found.
rules.message_not_applicable: No recognised major allergen was found in the ingredient text.

rules.name: Net weight declared in metric units

requirements.description: Unit is a recognised metric mass unit

rules.name: Declared calories per serving is a plausible, non-negative value
rules.message_fail: Declared calories-per-serving is outside a plausible range for a single serving.

rules.name: Servings per package is consistent with net weight / serving size
rules.description: servings_per_package should equal net_weight / serving_size within 1 serving of rounding tolerance -- a cross-field, calculated rule.
rules.message_not_applicable: Skipped because net-weight/unit could not first be confirmed.
